Make me a website
Here’s a complete, modern, one-page website you can use right away.Copy everything below, paste it into a file named index.html, and open it in your browser.
html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Horizon — A Simple Beautiful Site</title>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@300;400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #0f0f13;
      --card: #1a1a21;
      --accent: #7c5cff;
      --accent-2: #00d4ff;
      --text: #f0f0f5;
      --muted: #a0a0b0;
    }

    * {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    body {
      font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      line-height: 1.6;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    nav {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      width: 100%;
      padding: 1.2rem 5%;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      background: rgba(15, 15, 19, 0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      z-index: 100;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    }

    .logo {
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.4rem;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }

    .logo span { color: var(--accent); }

    nav a {
      color: var(--muted);
      text-decoration: none;
      margin-left: 2rem;
      font-weight: 400;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    nav a:hover { color: var(--text); }

    .hero {
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 0 8%;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse at top right, rgba(124, 92, 255, 0.15), transparent 50%),
                  radial-gradient(ellipse at bottom left, rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.08), transparent 50%);
    }

    .hero h1 {
      font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 7vw, 5.5rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.1;
      max-width: 800px;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }

    .hero h1 span {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2));
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    }

    .hero p {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      max-width: 540px;
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 0.9rem 2rem;
      background: var(--accent);
      color: white;
      text-decoration: none;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    }

    .btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(124, 92, 255, 0.35);
    }

    section {
      padding: 6rem 8%;
    }

    h2 {
      font-size: 2.2rem;
      margin-bottom: 3rem;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 2rem;
    }

    .card {
      background: var(--card);
      padding: 2rem;
      border-radius: 16px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      transition: transform 0.25s;
    }

    .card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); }

    .card h3 { margin-bottom: 0.8rem; font-size: 1.3rem; }
    .card p { color: var(--muted); }

    footer {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 3rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    }

    @media (max-width: 700px) {
      nav a { margin-left: 1.2rem; font-size: 0.9rem; }
      .hero { padding: 0 6%; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <nav>
    <div class="logo">Hori<span>zon</span></div>
    <div>
      <a href="#about">About</a>
      <a href="#work">Work</a>
      <a href="#contact">Contact</a>
    </div>
  </nav>

  <section class="hero">
    <h1>Build something<br><span>worth sharing.</span></h1>
    <p>A clean, fast, and modern starting point. Replace the text, colors, and sections with whatever you actually want to say.</p>
    <a href="#contact" class="btn">Get in touch</a>
  </section>

  <section id="about">
    <h2>What this is</h2>
    <div class="grid">
      <div class="card">
        <h3>Simple</h3>
        <p>One file. No frameworks required. Just open it and it works.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <h3>Fast</h3>
        <p>No bloat. Loads instantly and looks good on phones.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <h3>Yours</h3>
        <p>Change the colors, copy, and layout. Make it whatever you need.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="work">
    <h2>Next steps</h2>
    <div class="grid">
      <div class="card">
        <h3>1. Edit the text</h3>
        <p>Swap the headlines and paragraphs for your own story.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <h3>2. Change the colors</h3>
        <p>Update the CSS variables at the top of the &lt;style&gt; block.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <h3>3. Add your content</h3>
        <p>Drop in images, a form, or extra pages as you grow.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="contact">
    <h2>Say hello</h2>
    <p style="color: var(--muted); max-width: 500px;">
      This is just a placeholder. Replace this section with a real contact form, email link, or social links.
    </p>
  </section>

  <footer>
    Built as a starting point · Customize it however you like
  </footer>
</body>
</html>
How to use it
  1. Save the code as index.html
  2. Double-click the file to open it in any browser
  3. Edit the text, colors (the --accent variables), or sections
Want something different? Tell me:
  • What the site is for (portfolio, business, restaurant, personal blog, etc.)
  • Preferred colors or vibe (dark, light, colorful, minimal)
  • Any specific sections or features you need
I can revise it or add pages, a contact form, images, animations, etc.

  • personal brand / portfolio
  • company or shop
  • restaurant, studio, agency, app, etc.
  • language (English only, or also Arabic/another language)
  • colors, logo, photos, or contact details to include
I can then rewrite the copy, add pages, a contact form, or a specific layout.
Zabbadat is a movement toward better your overall health through learned coordination along with utilizing breathing/meditation techniques
Here’s a full site written for that purpose: movement, coordination, breath, and meditation as a path to better health. Save it as index.html and upload it to the hosting for zabbadat.com.
html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Zabbadat — Movement, Breath, Coordination</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Zabbadat is a movement toward better overall health through learned coordination, breathing, and meditation.">
  <link rel="canonical" href="https://www.zabbadat.com/">
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,500;0,600;1,500&family=Outfit:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #0e1412;
      --bg-2: #15201c;
      --card: #1b2723;
      --accent: #8fbfa8;
      --accent-2: #d7e8de;
      --text: #eef4f1;
      --muted: #9aada4;
    }

    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      line-height: 1.65;
    }

    nav {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      width: 100%;
      padding: 1.1rem 7%;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      background: rgba(14, 20, 18, 0.82);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      z-index: 100;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(143, 191, 168, 0.12);
    }

    .logo {
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
      font-size: 1.55rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    nav a {
      color: var(--muted);
      text-decoration: none;
      margin-left: 1.6rem;
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      font-weight: 400;
    }

    nav a:hover { color: var(--text); }

    .hero {
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 8rem 8% 5rem;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 75% 0%, rgba(143, 191, 168, 0.14), transparent 48%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 0% 100%, rgba(143, 191, 168, 0.06), transparent 42%);
    }

    .eyebrow {
      letter-spacing: 0.32em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: 1.3rem;
    }

    .hero h1 {
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
      font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 7vw, 5.6rem);
      font-weight: 500;
      line-height: 1.08;
      max-width: 16ch;
      margin-bottom: 1.4rem;
    }

    .hero h1 em {
      font-style: italic;
      color: var(--accent-2);
    }

    .hero p {
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      max-width: 34rem;
      margin-bottom: 2.3rem;
    }

    .actions { display: flex; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }

    .btn {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 0.9rem 1.7rem;
      background: var(--accent);
      color: #0e1412;
      text-decoration: none;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
    }

    .btn.ghost {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text);
      border: 1px solid rgba(239, 244, 241, 0.22);
    }

    section { padding: 5.2rem 8%; }

    h2 {
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.8rem);
      font-weight: 500;
      margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
    }

    .lead {
      color: var(--muted);
      max-width: 38rem;
      margin-bottom: 2.4rem;
    }

    .grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));
      gap: 1.25rem;
    }

    .card {
      background: var(--card);
      padding: 1.7rem;
      border-radius: 16px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(143, 191, 168, 0.1);
    }

    .card h3 {
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
      font-size: 1.45rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 0.55rem;
    }

    .card p { color: var(--muted); }

    .practice {
      background: var(--bg-2);
    }

    .steps {
      display: grid;
      gap: 1rem;
      max-width: 46rem;
    }

    .step {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 3rem 1fr;
      gap: 1rem;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .num {
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
      color: var(--accent);
      font-size: 1.6rem;
    }

    footer {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 2.2rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.86rem;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(143, 191, 168, 0.1);
    }

    @media (max-width: 700px) {
      nav a { margin-left: 0.9rem; font-size: 0.84rem; }
      .hero, section { padding-left: 6%; padding-right: 6%; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <nav>
    <div class="logo">Zabbadat</div>
    <div>
      <a href="#practice">Practice</a>
      <a href="#approach">Approach</a>
      <a href="#begin">Begin</a>
    </div>
  </nav>

  <section class="hero">
    <div class="eyebrow">A movement toward better health</div>
    <h1>Learn to move. <em>Learn to breathe.</em> Return to balance.</h1>
    <p>Zabbadat is a practice of overall health through learned coordination, breathwork, and meditation. The body becomes clearer when movement, attention, and breath work together.</p>
    <div class="actions">
      <a href="#begin" class="btn">Begin the practice</a>
      <a href="#approach" class="btn ghost">How it works</a>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="approach">
    <h2>Three threads, one practice</h2>
    <p class="lead">Health here is not a grind. It is coordination you can learn — how the body organizes itself, how the breath steadies the mind, and how attention settles both.</p>
    <div class="grid">
      <div class="card">
        <h3>Coordination</h3>
        <p>Simple, repeatable movement patterns that teach balance, timing, and control. You learn how parts of the body work as one system instead of isolated effort.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <h3>Breath</h3>
        <p>Breathing techniques that regulate the nervous system, support posture, and make movement quieter and more efficient.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <h3>Meditation</h3>
        <p>Attention training that sits inside the movement — not separate from it. Presence becomes a physical skill, not only an idea.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="practice" id="practice">
    <h2>What a session feels like</h2>
    <p class="lead">Each session builds from stillness into coordinated movement, then back to breath. The aim is a body that is more organized and a mind that is less scattered.</p>
    <div class="steps">
      <div class="step">
        <div class="num">01</div>
        <div>
          <h3>Arrive</h3>
          <p style="color:var(--muted)">Settle the breath. Notice posture, weight, and the space you are in.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="step">
        <div class="num">02</div>
        <div>
          <h3>Coordinate</h3>
          <p style="color:var(--muted)">Learn patterns that connect feet, hips, spine, and hands. Small corrections create large changes in ease.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="step">
        <div class="num">03</div>
        <div>
          <h3>Breathe through it</h3>
          <p style="color:var(--muted)">Use breath to pace effort, recover faster, and keep the nervous system from gripping.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="step">
        <div class="num">04</div>
        <div>
          <h3>Integrate</h3>
          <p style="color:var(--muted)">A short meditation so the practice lands — in walking, work, sleep, and daily movement.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="begin">
    <h2>Start where you are</h2>
    <p class="lead">Zabbadat is for anyone who wants better health without treating the body as a machine to be forced. No prior training required — only willingness to pay attention.</p>
    <div class="grid">
      <div class="card">
        <h3>Daily practice</h3>
        <p>Short sequences you can do at home: coordination drills, breath sets, and a closing sit.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <h3>Guided sessions</h3>
        <p>Live or recorded classes that walk you through the full method at a sustainable pace.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <h3>Get in touch</h3>
        <p>Questions, classes, or collaborations: <br>hello@zabbadat.com</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <footer>
    © 2026 Zabbadat · Movement, breath, and meditation · www.zabbadat.com
  </footer>
</body>
</html>
Replace hello@zabbadat.com with your real contact when you have it.If you want the next version to feel more finished, send any of these:
  • class schedule or pricing
  • whether this is in-person, online, or both
  • founder name / city
  • photos or a logo
  • language besides English
I can add a class list, a simple email form, or a quieter “first 10-minute practice” section on the homepage.

A static site can time games and record steps on the device. A shared live leaderboard across everyone’s phones needs a backend later. This version tracks score to 21, a running clock, steps, and a local leaderboard in the browser.

    }
    .hero h1 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--accent-2); }
    .hero p, .lead { color: var(--muted); max-width: 36rem; margin-bottom: 2rem; }

      display: inline-block; padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem;
      background: var(--accent); color: #0e1412;
      text-decoration: none; border: 0; border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit;

<body>
  <nav>
    <div class="logo">Zabbadat</div>
    <div>
      <a href="#approach">Practice</a>
      <a href="#washers">Washers</a>
      <a href="#play">Play</a>
    </div>
  </nav>

  <section class="hero">
    <div class="eyebrow">Movement · Breath · 10,000 steps</div>
    <h1>Better health through coordination. <em>A game that makes you walk.</em></h1>
    <p>Zabbadat is a movement toward overall health: learned coordination, breathing, and meditation — plus the Game of Washers. First to 21 wins. Fewest steps and fastest time decide how well you played.</p>
    <div class="actions">
      <a class="btn" href="#play">Track a game</a>
      <a class="btn ghost" href="#washers">How washers works</a>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="approach">
    <h2>The practice</h2>
    <p class="lead">Health is coordination you can learn. Breath steadies the system. Meditation keeps attention in the body. Walking 10,000 steps gives the day a spine — washers turns those steps into a contest.</p>
    <div class="grid">
      <div class="card"><h3>Coordination</h3><p>Patterns that organize feet, hips, and hands so movement costs less effort.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h3>Breath &amp; meditation</h3><p>Techniques that settle the nervous system before, during, and after play.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h3>10k steps</h3><p>The Game of Washers is built so getting to 21 also gets you moving.</p></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="washers" id="washers">
    <h2>Game of Washers</h2>
    <p class="lead">The premise: reach 21 with the fewest steps and the quickest time. Play outdoors, walk between tosses, and let the scoreboard keep you honest.</p>
    <div class="grid">
      <div class="card"><h3>Score to 21</h3><p>Points accumulate toward 21. The first player or team to 21 finishes the game.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h3>Fewest steps</h3><p>Every step counts. A cleaner path and smarter positioning beats wandering the yard.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h3>Fastest time</h3><p>The clock starts when you start playing and stops when you hit 21.</p></div>
    </div>
    <p class="note">This page can time the game and record the steps you enter. It cannot read Apple Health or Google Fit by itself. Enter steps from your watch or phone at the end — or tap them in as you walk. A shared worldwide leaderboard would need hosting with a database; this version saves results on this device.</p>
  </section>

  <section id="play">
    <h2>Play &amp; track</h2>
    <p class="lead">Start the clock, add points as you score, and log steps. When you hit 21, the result is saved to the board on this phone or computer.</p>

    <label for="player">Player name</label>
    <input id="player" type="text" placeholder="Your name" maxlength="40">

    <div class="stats">
      <div class="stat"><b id="score">0</b><span>Score / 21</span></div>
      <div class="stat"><b id="steps">0</b><span>Steps</span></div>
      <div class="stat"><b id="clock">00:00</b><span>Time</span></div>
    </div>

    <div class="row">
      <button class="btn" id="startBtn" type="button">Start game</button>
      <button class="btn ghost" id="pauseBtn" type="button">Pause</button>
      <button class="btn danger" id="resetBtn" type="button">Reset</button>
    </div>

    <div class="row">
      <button class="btn ghost" type="button" data-points="1">+1 point</button>
      <button class="btn ghost" type="button" data-points="3">+3 points</button>
      <button class="btn ghost" type="button" data-points="-1">−1 point</button>
    </div>

    <label for="stepAdd">Add steps</label>
    <div class="row">
      <input id="stepAdd" type="number" min="1" max="20000" placeholder="e.g. 250">
      <button class="btn ghost" id="addStepsBtn" type="button">Add steps</button>
      <button class="btn ghost" type="button" data-steps="10">+10</button>
      <button class="btn ghost" type="button" data-steps="50">+50</button>
      <button class="btn ghost" type="button" data-steps="100">+100</button>
    </div>

    <p class="note" id="status">Ready. Press start when the first washer is thrown.</p>

    <h3 style="margin-top:2rem;font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.6rem;">Board on this device</h3>
    <p class="note">Ranked by fewest steps, then fastest time. Only games that reached 21 are listed.</p>
    <table>
      <thead>
        <tr><th>#</th><th>Player</th><th>Steps</th><th>Time</th><th>When</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody id="board"></tbody>
    </table>
    <div class="row">
      <button class="btn ghost" id="clearBoardBtn" type="button">Clear board</button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <footer>© 2026 Zabbadat · www.zabbadat.com</footer>

  <script>
    const TARGET = 21;
    const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
    const state = {
      score: 0,
      steps: 0,
      running: false,
      startedAt: 0,
      elapsed: 0,
      tick: null,
      finished: false
    };

    function pad(n) { return String(n).padStart(2, '0'); }

    function formatTime(ms) {
      const total = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
      const m = Math.floor(total / 60);
      const s = total % 60;
      const h = Math.floor(m / 60);
      if (h > 0) return h + ':' + pad(m % 60) + ':' + pad(s);
      return pad(m) + ':' + pad(s);
    }

    function render() {
      $('score').textContent = state.score;
      $('steps').textContent = state.steps.toLocaleString();
      const now = state.running ? Date.now() - state.startedAt + state.elapsed : state.elapsed;
      $('clock').textContent = formatTime(now);
    }

    function setStatus(msg) { $('status').textContent = msg; }

    function loadBoard() {
      try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('zabbadat-washers') || '[]'); }
      catch { return []; }
    }

    function saveBoard(rows) {
      localStorage.setItem('zabbadat-washers', JSON.stringify(rows));
    }

    function renderBoard() {
      const rows = loadBoard().sort((a, b) => a.steps - b.steps || a.ms - b.ms);
      $('board').innerHTML = rows.length
        ? rows.map((r, i) => `<tr><td>${i + 1}</td><td>${r.name}</td><td>${r.steps.toLocaleString()}</td><td>${formatTime(r.ms)}</td><td>${r.when}</td></tr>`).join('')
        : '<tr><td colspan="5">No finished games yet.</td></tr>';
    }

    function finishGame() {
      if (state.finished) return;
      state.running = false;
      state.finished = true;
      clearInterval(state.tick);
      const ms = state.elapsed + (state.startedAt ? Date.now() - state.startedAt : 0);
      state.elapsed = ms;
      const name = ($('player').value || 'Player').trim();
      const rows = loadBoard();
      rows.push({
        name,
        steps: state.steps,
        ms,
        when: new Date().toLocaleString()
      });
      saveBoard(rows);
      renderBoard();
      setStatus(name + ' finished at 21 in ' + formatTime(ms) + ' with ' + state.steps.toLocaleString() + ' steps.');
      render();
    }

    $('startBtn').onclick = () => {
      if (state.finished) return;
      if (state.running) return;
      state.running = true;
      state.startedAt = Date.now();
      state.tick = setInterval(render, 200);
      setStatus('Game on. Add points and steps as you play.');
      render();
    };

    $('pauseBtn').onclick = () => {
      if (!state.running || state.finished) return;
      state.elapsed += Date.now() - state.startedAt;
      state.running = false;
      clearInterval(state.tick);
      setStatus('Paused.');
      render();
    };

    $('resetBtn').onclick = () => {
      clearInterval(state.tick);
      Object.assign(state, { score: 0, steps: 0, running: false, startedAt: 0, elapsed: 0, tick: null, finished: false });
      setStatus('Reset. Press start when you are ready.');
      render();
    };

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-points]').forEach(btn => {
      btn.onclick = () => {
        if (state.finished) return;
        if (!state.running && state.elapsed === 0) {
          setStatus('Start the game before scoring.');
          return;
        }
        state.score = Math.max(0, state.score + Number(btn.dataset.points));
        render();
        if (state.score >= TARGET) finishGame();
      };
    });

    function addSteps(n) {
      if (state.finished || !n) return;
      state.steps += n;
      render();
    }

    $('addStepsBtn').onclick = () => {
      addSteps(Number($('stepAdd').value) || 0);
      $('stepAdd').value = '';
    };

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-steps]').forEach(btn => {
      btn.onclick = () => addSteps(Number(btn.dataset.steps));
    });

    $('clearBoardBtn').onclick = () => {
      if (confirm('Clear the board saved on this device?')) {
        saveBoard([]);
        renderBoard();
      }
    };

    render();
    renderBoard();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
What this does now
  • Timer start / pause / reset
  • Score buttons toward 21
  • Step logging (+10 / +50 / +100 or a custom number)
  • Saves finished games on that phone or computer
  • Ranks by fewest steps, then fastest time
What a website cannot do by itself
  • Read a Fitbit, Apple Watch, or Google Fit step count automatically
  • Show one public leaderboard for every player in the world
Those two need an app permission or a small backend (Firebase, Supabase, etc.). If you want that next, say whether players should sign in, and I can sketch the hosted version.
yes i want that next
A shared board across phones needs a tiny backend. The version below uses Firebase with silent anonymous sign-in (no account wall). When someone hits 21, the result is written to a public leaderboard ranked by fewest steps, then fastest time.Save this as index.html. It still works locally if Firebase is not set up yet; the global board turns on after the setup steps at the bottom.

    <p class="note" id="cloudStatus">Connecting to the live board…</p>

    <label for="player">Player name</label>
    <input id="player" type="text" placeholder="Your name" maxlength="40">

    <div class="stats">
      <div class="stat"><b id="score">0</b><span>Score / 21</span></div>
      <div class="stat"><b id="steps">0</b><span>Steps</span></div>
      <div class="stat"><b id="clock">00:00</b><span>Time</span></div>
    </div>

    <div class="row">
      <button class="btn" id="startBtn" type="button">Start game</button>
      <button class="btn ghost" id="pauseBtn" type="button">Pause</button>
      <button class="btn danger" id="resetBtn" type="button">Reset</button>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
      <button class="btn ghost" type="button" data-points="1">+1 point</button>
      <button class="btn ghost" type="button" data-points="3">+3 points</button>
      <button class="btn ghost" type="button" data-points="-1">−1 point</button>
    </div>

    <label for="stepAdd">Add steps (from your watch / phone)</label>
    <div class="row">
      <input id="stepAdd" type="number" min="1" max="20000" placeholder="e.g. 250">
      <button class="btn ghost" id="addStepsBtn" type="button">Add steps</button>
      <button class="btn ghost" type="button" data-steps="10">+10</button>
      <button class="btn ghost" type="button" data-steps="50">+50</button>
      <button class="btn ghost" type="button" data-steps="100">+100</button>
    </div>
    <p class="note" id="status">Ready. Press start when the first washer is thrown.</p>
  </section>

  <section id="board">
    <h2>Live board</h2>
    <p class="lead">Public results from finished games. Ranked by fewest steps, then fastest time.</p>
    <table>
      <thead>
        <tr><th>#</th><th>Player</th><th>Steps</th><th>Time</th><th>When</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody id="boardBody"><tr><td colspan="5">Waiting for games…</td></tr></tbody>
    </table>
    <p class="note">This site cannot read Apple Health or Fitbit automatically. Players enter the step count the watch already recorded.</p>
  </section>

  <footer>© 2026 Zabbadat · www.zabbadat.com</footer>

  <script type="module">
    /* 1. Paste your Firebase web config here after you create the project */
    const firebaseConfig = {
      apiKey: "PASTE_API_KEY",
      authDomain: "YOUR_PROJECT.firebaseapp.com",
      projectId: "YOUR_PROJECT_ID",
      storageBucket: "YOUR_PROJECT.appspot.com",
      messagingSenderId: "PASTE",
      appId: "PASTE"
    };

    const TARGET = 21;
    const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
    const configured = firebaseConfig.apiKey !== "PASTE_API_KEY";

    const state = {
      score: 0, steps: 0, running: false, startedAt: 0, elapsed: 0, tick: null, finished: false
    };

    function pad(n) { return String(n).padStart(2, "0"); }
    function formatTime(ms) {
      const total = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
      const m = Math.floor(total / 60);
      const s = total % 60;
      const h = Math.floor(m / 60);
      return h > 0 ? h + ":" + pad(m % 60) + ":" + pad(s) : pad(m) + ":" + pad(s);
    }
    function render() {
      $("score").textContent = state.score;
      $("steps").textContent = state.steps.toLocaleString();
      const now = state.running ? Date.now() - state.startedAt + state.elapsed : state.elapsed;
      $("clock").textContent = formatTime(now);
    }
    function setStatus(msg) { $("status").textContent = msg; }

    function localBoard() {
      try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("zabbadat-washers") || "[]"); }
      catch { return []; }
    }
    function paintRows(rows) {
      const sorted = [...rows].sort((a, b) => a.steps - b.steps || a.ms - b.ms).slice(0, 50);
      $("boardBody").innerHTML = sorted.length
        ? sorted.map((r, i) => `<tr><td>${i + 1}</td><td>${escapeHtml(r.name)}</td><td>${Number(r.steps).toLocaleString()}</td><td>${formatTime(r.ms)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(r.when || "")}</td></tr>`).join("")
        : `<tr><td colspan="5">No finished games yet.</td></tr>`;
    }
    function escapeHtml(s) {
      return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]));
    }

    let saveRemote = async () => {};

    $("startBtn").onclick = () => {
      if (state.finished || state.running) return;
      state.running = true;
      state.startedAt = Date.now();
      state.tick = setInterval(render, 200);
      setStatus("Game on. Add points and steps as you play.");
      render();
    };
    $("pauseBtn").onclick = () => {
      if (!state.running || state.finished) return;
      state.elapsed += Date.now() - state.startedAt;
      state.running = false;
      clearInterval(state.tick);
      setStatus("Paused.");
      render();
    };
    $("resetBtn").onclick = () => {
      clearInterval(state.tick);
      Object.assign(state, { score: 0, steps: 0, running: false, startedAt: 0, elapsed: 0, tick: null, finished: false });
      setStatus("Reset. Press start when you are ready.");
      render();
    };
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-points]").forEach((btn) => {
      btn.onclick = () => {
        if (state.finished) return;
        if (!state.running && state.elapsed === 0) { setStatus("Start the game before scoring."); return; }
        state.score = Math.max(0, state.score + Number(btn.dataset.points));
        render();
        if (state.score >= TARGET) finishGame();
      };
    });
    function addSteps(n) {
      if (state.finished || !n) return;
      state.steps += n;
      render();
    }
    $("addStepsBtn").onclick = () => {
      addSteps(Number($("stepAdd").value) || 0);
      $("stepAdd").value = "";
    };
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-steps]").forEach((btn) => {
      btn.onclick = () => addSteps(Number(btn.dataset.steps));
    });

    async function finishGame() {
      if (state.finished) return;
      state.running = false;
      state.finished = true;
      clearInterval(state.tick);
      const ms = state.elapsed + (state.startedAt ? Date.now() - state.startedAt : 0);
      state.elapsed = ms;
      const name = ($("player").value || "Player").trim().slice(0, 40);
      const record = { name, score: 21, steps: state.steps, ms, when: new Date().toLocaleString() };
      const local = localBoard();
      local.push(record);
      localStorage.setItem("zabbadat-washers", JSON.stringify(local));
      render();
      try {
        await saveRemote(record);
        setStatus(name + " posted: 21 in " + formatTime(ms) + " with " + state.steps.toLocaleString() + " steps.");
      } catch (err) {
        paintRows(local);
        setStatus(name + " finished locally. Live board error: " + (err.message || err));
      }
    }

    paintRows(localBoard());
    render();

    if (!configured) {
      $("cloudStatus").className = "note bad";
      $("cloudStatus").textContent = "Live board is not connected yet. Paste your Firebase config in this file. Games still save on this device.";
    } else {
      const { initializeApp } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.0.2/firebase-app.js");
      const { getAuth, signInAnonymously, onAuthStateChanged } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.0.2/firebase-auth.js");
      const { getFirestore, collection, addDoc, query, orderBy, limit, onSnapshot, serverTimestamp } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.0.2/firebase-firestore.js");

      const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
      const auth = getAuth(app);
      const db = getFirestore(app);

      saveRemote = async (record) => {
        await addDoc(collection(db, "games"), {
          name: record.name,
          score: 21,
          steps: Number(record.steps),
          ms: Number(record.ms),
          createdAt: serverTimestamp()
        });
      };

      onAuthStateChanged(auth, async (user) => {
        if (!user) {
          try { await signInAnonymously(auth); }
          catch (e) {
            $("cloudStatus").className = "note bad";
            $("cloudStatus").textContent = "Could not sign in anonymously. Enable Anonymous auth in Firebase.";
          }
          return;
        }
        $("cloudStatus").className = "note ok";
        $("cloudStatus").textContent = "Live board connected. Finished games will appear for everyone.";
      });

      const q = query(collection(db, "games"), orderBy("steps", "asc"), limit(80));
      onSnapshot(q, (snap) => {
        const rows = snap.docs.map((d) => {
          const x = d.data();
          const when = x.createdAt && x.createdAt.toDate ? x.createdAt.toDate().toLocaleString() : "";
          return { name: x.name, steps: x.steps, ms: x.ms, when };
        }).sort((a, b) => a.steps - b.steps || a.ms - b.ms);
        paintRows(rows);
      }, () => {
        $("cloudStatus").className = "note bad";
        $("cloudStatus").textContent = "Could not read the live board. Check Firestore rules and indexes.";
        paintRows(localBoard());
      });
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>
Set up the live board (about 10 minutes)
  1. Go to https://console.firebase.google.com and create a project (name it zabbadat).
  2. Click Build → Authentication → Sign-in method → Anonymous → Enable.
  3. Click Build → Firestore Database → Create database → Start in production mode. Pick a region.
  4. Open the Rules tab and paste this, then Publish:
rules_version = '2';
service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {
    match /games/{id} {
      allow read: if true;
      allow create: if request.auth != null
        && request.resource.data.score == 21
        && request.resource.data.steps is int
        && request.resource.data.steps > 0
        && request.resource.data.steps < 100000
        && request.resource.data.ms is int
        && request.resource.data.ms >= 5000
        && request.resource.data.ms < 86400000
        && request.resource.data.name is string
        && request.resource.data.name.size() > 0
        && request.resource.data.name.size() <= 40;
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
  }
}
  1. In Firestore, you may be asked to create an index on steps. If the board fails to load, use the link in the browser error — accept the suggested index (steps ascending).
  2. Project settings (gear) → Your apps → Web (</>) → copy the firebaseConfig object into the file where it says PASTE_API_KEY.
  3. Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains: add zabbadat.com and www.zabbadat.com.
  4. Upload index.html to the hosting tied to the domain (Firebase Hosting, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, or your registrar).
What this gives you
  • Timer, score to 21, step logging
  • Results saved on the device and on the public board
  • No login screen (anonymous session in the background)
  • Rules block junk scores (must be 21, steps and time in range)
It still cannot pull steps from Apple Watch by itself. Players copy the number from the watch at the end of the game.If you want the next layer after this is live: Google sign-in so names stay consistent, or a two-player mode on one screen.
Add Google Sign-In for consistent names
Google Sign-In will lock the board name to the Google account, so the same person keeps the same name across phones.Replace your page with this version. After you paste your Firebase config, enable the Google provider using the steps under the code.

      clearInterval(state.tick);
      setStatus("Paused.");
      render();
    };
    $("resetBtn").onclick = () => {
      clearInterval(state.tick);
      Object.assign(state, { score: 0, steps: 0, running: false, startedAt: 0, elapsed: 0, tick: null, finished: false });
      setStatus("Reset.");
      render();
    };
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-points]").forEach((btn) => {
      btn.onclick = () => {
        if (state.finished) return;
        if (!state.running && state.elapsed === 0) { setStatus("Start the game before scoring."); return; }
        state.score = Math.max(0, state.score + Number(btn.dataset.points));
        render();
        if (state.score >= TARGET) finishGame();
      };
    });
    function addSteps(n) {
      if (state.finished || !n) return;
      state.steps += n;
      render();
    }
    $("addStepsBtn").onclick = () => { addSteps(Number($("stepAdd").value) || 0); $("stepAdd").value = ""; };
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-steps]").forEach((btn) => {
      btn.onclick = () => addSteps(Number(btn.dataset.steps));
    });

    async function finishGame() {
      if (state.finished) return;
      state.running = false;
      state.finished = true;
      clearInterval(state.tick);
      const ms = state.elapsed + (state.startedAt ? Date.now() - state.startedAt : 0);
      state.elapsed = ms;
      const name = currentUser ? displayNameOf(currentUser) : ($("player").value || "Player").trim().slice(0, 40);
      const record = { name, score: 21, steps: state.steps, ms, when: new Date().toLocaleString() };
      const local = localBoard();
      local.push(record);
      localStorage.setItem("zabbadat-washers", JSON.stringify(local));
      render();
      if (!currentUser) {
        paintRows(local);
        setStatus("Finished on this device only. Sign in with Google to post to the live board.");
        return;
      }
      try {
        await saveRemote(record);
        setStatus(name + " posted: 21 in " + formatTime(ms) + " with " + state.steps.toLocaleString() + " steps.");
      } catch (err) {
        paintRows(local);
        setStatus("Saved locally. Live post failed: " + (err.message || err));
      }
    }

    paintRows(localBoard());
    render();

    if (!configured) {
      $("cloudStatus").className = "note bad";
      $("cloudStatus").textContent = "Paste your Firebase config, then enable Google Sign-In.";
      $("signInBtn").onclick = () => alert("Add Firebase config first.");
      return;
    }

    const { initializeApp } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.0.2/firebase-app.js");
    const {
      getAuth, GoogleAuthProvider, signInWithPopup, signInWithRedirect,
      getRedirectResult, signOut, onAuthStateChanged
    } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.0.2/firebase-auth.js");
    const {
      getFirestore, collection, addDoc, query, orderBy, limit, onSnapshot, serverTimestamp
    } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.0.2/firebase-firestore.js");

    const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
    const auth = getAuth(app);
    const db = getFirestore(app);
    const provider = new GoogleAuthProvider();

    saveRemote = async (record) => {
      if (!auth.currentUser) throw new Error("Sign in required");
      await addDoc(collection(db, "games"), {
        name: displayNameOf(auth.currentUser),
        uid: auth.currentUser.uid,
        score: 21,
        steps: Number(record.steps),
        ms: Number(record.ms),
        createdAt: serverTimestamp()
      });
    };

    function showUser(user) {
      currentUser = user;
      const signedIn = !!(user && user.providerData.some((p) => p.providerId === "google.com"));
      if (signedIn) {
        $("whoName").textContent = displayNameOf(user);
        $("player").value = displayNameOf(user);
        $("signInBtn").hidden = true;
        $("signOutBtn").hidden = false;
        $("cloudStatus").className = "note ok";
        $("cloudStatus").textContent = "Signed in with Google. Finished games post under this name.";
        if (user.photoURL) {
          let img = document.getElementById("avatar");
          if (!img) {
            img = document.createElement("img");
            img.id = "avatar";
            img.alt = "";
            $("who").prepend(img);
          }
          img.src = user.photoURL;
        }
      } else {
        currentUser = null;
        $("whoName").textContent = "Not signed in";
        $("player").value = "";
        $("signInBtn").hidden = false;
        $("signOutBtn").hidden = true;
        const img = document.getElementById("avatar");
        if (img) img.remove();
        $("cloudStatus").className = "note";
        $("cloudStatus").textContent = "Live board is on. Sign in with Google to post a consistent name.";
      }
    }

    $("signInBtn").onclick = async () => {
      try {
        await signInWithPopup(auth, provider);
      } catch (e) {
        if (e.code === "auth/popup-blocked" || e.code === "auth/operation-not-supported-in-this-environment") {
          await signInWithRedirect(auth, provider);
          return;
        }
        setStatus("Google sign-in failed: " + (e.message || e.code));
      }
    };
    $("signOutBtn").onclick = () => signOut(auth);
    getRedirectResult(auth).catch(() => {});

    onAuthStateChanged(auth, showUser);

    const q = query(collection(db, "games"), orderBy("steps", "asc"), limit(80));
    onSnapshot(q, (snap) => {
      const rows = snap.docs.map((d) => {
        const x = d.data();
        const when = x.createdAt && x.createdAt.toDate ? x.createdAt.toDate().toLocaleString() : "";
        return { name: x.name, steps: x.steps, ms: x.ms, when };
      }).sort((a, b) => a.steps - b.steps || a.ms - b.ms);
      paintRows(rows);
    }, () => paintRows(localBoard()));
  </script>
</body>
</html>
Extra Firebase steps for Google
  1. Firebase Console → Authentication → Sign-in method → Google → Enable.
    Set a project support email and save.
  2. Keep Anonymous off unless you still want guest posting. This version posts to the live board only after Google Sign-In.
  3. Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains: add localhost, zabbadat.com, and www.zabbadat.com.
  4. Update Firestore rules so only a signed-in Google user can create a game, and the stored name must match their account name:
rules_version = '2';
service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {
    match /games/{id} {
      allow read: if true;
      allow create: if request.auth != null
        && request.auth.token.firebase.sign_in_provider == 'google.com'
        && request.resource.data.uid == request.auth.uid
        && request.resource.data.score == 21
        && request.resource.data.steps is int
        && request.resource.data.steps > 0
        && request.resource.data.steps < 100000
        && request.resource.data.ms is int
        && request.resource.data.ms >= 5000
        && request.resource.data.ms < 86400000
        && request.resource.data.name == request.auth.token.name
        && request.resource.data.name.size() > 0
        && request.resource.data.name.size() <= 40;
      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
  }
}
If a create is rejected because request.auth.token.name is missing on some accounts, loosen that one line to:&& request.resource.data.name is string && request.resource.data.name.size() > 0 && request.resource.data.name.size() <= 40The site still uses the Google display name in code either way.
  1. Paste your web firebaseConfig where it says PASTE_API_KEY, then upload the file.
Unsigned visitors can still run a local game. Only a Google session can publish, and the published name is the Google profile name.
Configure Firestore Security Rules
I cannot open your Firebase project from here. Paste the rules below into the console and publish them.Where to put them
  1. Firebase Console → your Zabbadat project
  2. Build → Firestore Database → Rules
  3. Replace everything in the editor with the block below
  4. Publish
rules_version = '2';
service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {

    function isGoogleUser() {
      return request.auth != null
        && request.auth.token.firebase.sign_in_provider == 'google.com';
    }

    function validName() {
      return request.resource.data.name is string
        && request.resource.data.name.size() > 0
        && request.resource.data.name.size() <= 40;
    }

    function validGame() {
      return request.resource.data.score == 21
        && request.resource.data.steps is int
        && request.resource.data.steps > 0
        && request.resource.data.steps < 100000
        && request.resource.data.ms is int
        && request.resource.data.ms >= 5000
        && request.resource.data.ms < 86400000
        && request.resource.data.uid == request.auth.uid
        && validName();
    }

    match /games/{id} {
      allow read: if true;

      allow create: if isGoogleUser() && validGame();

      allow update, delete: if false;
    }
  }
}
What these rules do
  • Anyone can read the live board
  • Only a Google-signed-in user can create a finished game
  • The stored uid must be that user’s Firebase uid
  • Score must be 21
  • Steps must be an integer from 1 to 99,999
  • Time must be at least 5 seconds and under 24 hours
  • Name must be 1–40 characters
  • Nobody can edit or delete posted games from the client
If Publish complains about an indexThe site queries games ordered by steps. If Firestore shows a link to create an index, open it and create:
  • Collection: games
  • Field: steps — Ascending
  • Query scope: Collection
After publishing
  1. Authentication → Sign-in method → Google enabled
  2. Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains includes zabbadat.com and www.zabbadat.com
  3. Your index.html still has a real firebaseConfig (not PASTE_API_KEY)
Then sign in with Google, finish a game to 21, and confirm a new document appears under Firestore → Data → games.
